question: Does the SU(2) private-link Jacobian of the cut-off average keep sigma_min >= sigma_0 = 0.031 and the global transport |Y| <= 69.7 on calm, shell and large fields?
connection_to_goal: SHELL_TRANSPORT reduces averaged Conjecture B to the large-field displacement H, using a global transport field bounded by |dc|/sigma_0. This checks the two constants that reduction relies on before it is written up.
cpu_baseline: Pure numpy on 2x2 matrices; 60000 configurations with about 130 cut-off evaluations each fits in well under an hour on one core.
expected_result: Minimum singular value at least 0.03105 in every regime and transport operator norm at most about 69.7; in practice both should have large slack, with Y = 0 when m > 1.
decision_rule: A violation means the transport bound or the lemma's constant is wrong and the reduction must be withdrawn and audited. A pass is labelled heuristic only and does not replace the proof.
resource_justification: One CPU, 1 GB and two hours cover the sampling loop with ample margin; no GPU, since 2x2 linear algebra gains nothing from an accelerator.
stop_rule: Single seed, fixed sample count. Stop at the two-hour limit or on any exception; do not escalate scale before the first result is read.
